record.what_it_does: Gumroad is a digital commerce platform that lets creators sell digital products, memberships, and physical goods, and its v2 REST API exposes products, sales, subscribers, offer codes, licenses, and resource-subscription webhooks.
record.auth_notes: For a single account, a developer can click 'Generate access token' on a self-created application without running the OAuth flow. For a multi-user agent toolkit acting on behalf of other Gumroad users, the full OAuth2 authorization-code flow (client_id/client_secret, redirect_uri, scopes) is required, documented at gumroad.com/help/article/280-create-application-api.
record.access_notes: Any Gumroad account holder can go to Settings > Advanced, create an application, and immediately generate an access token or set up OAuth2 credentials — no app review or paid plan is mentioned in the vendor's own documentation.

evidence.quote: Your access token is used in the request header of every request to the API and should be kept secret, like a password.
you can use the Gumroad Omniauth gem to enable "Sign in with Gumroad" in your software
if you only want to use the API on your own Gumroad account, you can manually generate an access token, which is a simpler process
The Gumroad OAuth API is based around REST. We return JSON for every request, including errors.
Gumroad does offer refund notifications through its API, as a "resource subscription".
The Gumroad MCP server is an implementation of the Model Context Protocol that connects your AI agent and assistants like Claude, Cursor, etc directly to your Gumroad account.
